researchIntent.decisionToInform: Decide whether Station Zero v3's current Command -> Preview -> Commit -> Aftermath expression is understandable enough for fresh players to exercise the delegation/causal-reconstruction loop, or whether the smallest L2 expression/usability repair is required before broader content/value work.
researchIntent.researchQuestion: Can fresh players, without implementation documentation, form a minimally correct model of indirect specialist control and reconstruct the important causes of one Turn well enough to make a reasoned second Order?

targetOfInquiry.providerCondition: fixture/deterministic cognition for the primary C1/C2 canary
targetOfInquiry.playerContext: fresh adult participant, comfortable reading the current English UI, no prior Station Zero/Ordivon implementation exposure, desktop/laptop browser

maySupport: bounded usability of the tested current UI flow
bounded evidence that the participant understood indirect specialist control
bounded evidence that the participant could distinguish major causal contributors after one Turn
an owner-local L2 repair decision when a clear repeated or severe comprehension defect is observed
mustNotSupport: accessibility fit for populations not represented by the session context
claimBoundary.transportLimits: Findings are current only for the exact Game source/evaluation condition and the observed participant/session context. A source, scenario, presentation, provider, language, device-class or interaction change requires impact review before reuse.

evaluationLogic.method: moderated formative qualitative playtest using direct observation, pre-Commit prediction, post-Aftermath causal reconstruction, and neutral contextual probing
primaryTasks: Without implementation documentation, identify the player's role and make one meaningful first Commander Order.
Before Commit, predict what the three specialists are trying to do and name one plausible failure/contest source.
After Aftermath, explain which important outcomes were caused by Commander intent, specialist action, enemy contest, or environmental pressure.
Make a second Commander Order and explain what changed because of the previous Turn.
observations: whether environmental pressure is noticed before punishment
whether normal UI forces implementation/provider/internal-token language
whether the second Order responds to observed consequences
preStudyFalsifiers: The participant cannot exercise the declared loop because of a control, rendering, browser, or reset defect.
The moderator must explain the delegation model before the participant can make a meaningful first Order.
The participant repeatedly attributes specialist decisions to direct player control despite the current presentation.
Aftermath presentation does not permit the participant to distinguish at least the major observed causal contributors without being told the answer.
A source/evaluation-condition change occurs between sessions and the evidence is silently pooled.

canarySamplePlan.rationale: Small formative canary for mechanism/usability discovery, not prevalence estimation. Review information power and heterogeneity after each session; repair clear severe defects before spending additional participants on stale reality.

decisionRule.repairAndRetest: Admit the smallest owner-local expression/usability repair when a clear severe defect blocks the mechanism in one session or a materially similar comprehension failure recurs across independent fresh sessions. Changed reality starts a new evidence cut; do not pool pre/post-repair sessions as one condition.
decisionRule.boundedSupport: Only after at least three independent completed fresh-player sessions on the exact same condition, with no unresolved mechanism-blocking defect and with participants able by the second Turn to act on an adequately correct delegation/causal model without moderator instruction, may the C1/C2 claim be marked SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE.
decisionRule.contradiction: Repeated material inability to form or use the required delegation/causal model on the same exact condition supports CONTRADICTED_WITHIN_SCOPE for the corresponding C1/C2 claim.
decisionRule.inconclusive: Apparatus failure, leading intervention, incomplete session, inconsistent condition, or heterogeneous evidence that does not discriminate the decision yields INCONCLUSIVE rather than PASS.

participantSafetyAndPrivacy.eligibility: Adults only for this canary. Participation is voluntary; the participant may stop at any time without explanation.
participantSafetyAndPrivacy.dataMinimization: Use a non-identifying participant/session label. Do not collect demographics, health data, account credentials, or other sensitive personal information for this canary.
participantSafetyAndPrivacy.recording: No audio/video recording by default. If recording is later required, obtain separate explicit consent and freeze retention/access rules before the session.
participantSafetyAndPrivacy.publicationBoundary: This packet is internal product research. Reuse as publishable human-subject research requires a separate ethics/institutional review decision where applicable.

evidenceState.reason: No real participant session has been observed under this packet.

reopenConditions: Game source/evaluation condition changes before or during the canary
a participant is not actually fresh to Station Zero/Ordivon implementation
a severe apparatus defect prevents the intended loop
new Human evidence contradicts the current bounded standing
the product decision changes from C1/C2 comprehension to experience, preference, accessibility, population or causal-effect claims

apparatusPreflight.authorityBoundary: This proves the exact apparatus is mechanically executable enough to expose to a participant. It is not Human evidence and does not upgrade any C1/C2/C3 standing.
